explanation: The execution is faulty because the evidence_sources handoff uses source ids as record_id values, so downstream priority ranking cannot join provenance ranks to need record ids and all upstream_rank values become 0. The visible responsible code is upstream assemble_provenance, which constructs each provenance row with record_id set from source_id instead of preserving the need record_id.
cited_evidence: job_1 assemble_provenance source: records.append({'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index})
job_2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while job_2 input needs contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
job_2 prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks it up by coverage.record_id, producing observed priorities with upstream_rank: 0 for every record.
